reason: The spool is turned and six-fold symmetric about its axis (a six-hole circle at 60° pitch on one end, twelve-hole circles at 30° on both flanges). The anchors distinctive enough to align by all lie on the axis; the off-axis repeats (holes, chamfers and their faces) then vote for the turn about it, and six turns fit them equally (alignment.fold 6, symmetric set). Which copy is which is undetermined by the geometry, so, as for any symmetric part, the turn giving the motion nearest the identity is taken and every off-axis feature and face is carried, consistently, onto its image under that turn: here a 30° turn rather than the motion's own, so the 42 off-axis features and 72 faces land on their symmetric copies. Under translate, rot_x90 and rot_y180 the identity-nearest turn is the motion's own and everything is carried to itself.

Twelve pairs of degenerate strip faces (about 3e-8 mm² each, for example faces 6 and 29, whose supports run some 27 mm) are each a native ruled B-spline whose only partner is the other of its pair, joined G1, with centroids about 2 µm apart. Their freeform-surface fingerprints carry no size and the same traits and neighbourhood, so the two records of a pair are alike within the correspondence margin and each is reported ambiguous between the two (with a question), not guessed; every face is still carried to itself. Which is which is decidable only below the fingerprint's placement resolution.

The resized corner round is recognised twice: as the fillet the case's expectation names (fillets, adapted, radius 5 to 8) and as the straight convex blend over the same cylinder face (blends, ported after the case was written). The blend is reported adapted with sizes.radius 5.0 to 8.0 and its axis point moved by the radius change, which is the true change: the round's radius is 5 in the old part and 8 in the new (tools/capture_revisions.py). The check expects every feature it does not name to be carried; the case (expected.json) names only the fillets family because Python's aggregate prefers the dimension-worthy Fillet for a complete chain (build_recognition_result, not ported). A blends expectation in the case would retire this entry.
